# Pull request

## Summary

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Safety and authorization

- [ ] The change preserves scope enforcement and approval boundaries.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no secrets or target data.
- [ ] Destructive behavior remains denied by default.
- [ ] New external actions or images are pinned to immutable identifiers.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] Maintained English Markdown has a matching `.zh-TW.md` document.
- [ ] No documentation update is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] The change is focused and backward compatibility was considered.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `SECURITY.md`.
